turns.question: How many tracks does each of them have? Show the title and the count.

turns.question: Which of those albums is the longest in total running time?
turns.gold_sql: SELECT a.title FROM album a JOIN artist r ON r.artist_id = a.artist_id JOIN track t ON t.album_id = a.album_id WHERE r.name = 'Led Zeppelin' GROUP BY a.album_id, a.title ORDER BY sum(t.milliseconds) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT title, album_id
FROM album

    SELECT album_id
    FROM track
    JOIN album ON track.album_id = album.album_id

turns.question: Who is the top-spending customer from Canada? Give their first and last name.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'Canada' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY sum(i.total) DESC LIMIT 1
turns.sql:
SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name
FROM customer c
JOIN (
    SELECT customer_id, MAX(total) as max_total
    FROM invoice
    WHERE country = 'Canada'
    GROUP BY customer_id
) subq ON c.customer_id = subq.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_id = subq.customer_id

turns.question: What is the average track length in minutes for each media type? Show the media type name and the average.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT m.name, avg(t.milliseconds) / 60000.0 AS avg_minutes FROM track t JOIN media_type m ON m.media_type_id = t.media_type_id GROUP BY m.media_type_id, m.name
turns.sql:
SELECT 
    mt.name AS media_type_name,
    AVG(track.milliseconds / 60000) AS average_track_length_minutes
FROM 
    media_type mt
JOIN 
    track ON mt.media_type_id = track.media_type_id
GROUP BY 
    mt.name

turns.question: Who are the top 3 customers by total spending? Show first name, last name and the total spent, highest first.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, sum(i.total) AS spent FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 3
turns.sql:
SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS total_spent
FROM customer c
JOIN invoice i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
JOIN invoice_line il ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id
GROUP BY c.first_name, c.last_name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 3;
